name: Ravash Mog
description: Bani's red-haired duel sister, killed when Lim-Dûl exploits her fear of paralysis.

description_citations.text: "Shandalar (comic)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bani Bakur and Ravash Mog arrive on flying seahorses and save the Shadowwood dark elves from human zombies.
timeline.quote: The duel sisters Bani Bakur and Ravash Mog arrive on flying seahorses and smite the zombies with their enchanted weapons.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 1: Exiles In The Promised Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Ardestan Bani senses alien corruption in the mana currents while Ravash demands Sahrmal return, though he has been absent for twelve years.
timeline.quote: Bani says that he has been absent for twelve years

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 1: Exiles In The Promised Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The real Lim-Dûl, who was only a mana manifestation when burned, appears in the Catacombs and poses as the crone Magus to the duel sisters, who believe she is Sahrmal.
timeline.quote: As Baki and Ravash enter the Catacombs, they meet Magus and are led to believe that it is Kenan Sahrmal in disguise.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 1: Exiles In The Promised Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Magus sends bats; Bani is crippled by fear and Lim-Dûl casts Mind Whip on Ravash, who falls to her death. Bani vows to kill Szat.
timeline.quote: Ravash slips on the edge of a precipice and falls to her death.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 1: Exiles In The Promised Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
